listening.title: Waiting for the weekly meeting to start

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Executive)
lines.text: Morning, Tuan! You look a bit tired today. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Tuan (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Morning, Lan. I was stuck in traffic for almost an hour. The rain made everything slow.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Executive)
lines.text: Oh no. The rainy season is always hard for people who ride motorbikes.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Exactly. Next week I will leave earlier to avoid the rush hour.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Executive)
lines.text: Good idea. By the way, have you seen Hoa? I heard she came back from Germany.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Yes, she arrived last night. She said she has terrible jet lag, so she is working from home today.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Executive)
lines.text: That makes sense. I hope she gets some rest before the training on Thursday.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Me too. Anyway, how was your weekend?

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Executive)
lines.text: Quiet, actually. I was feeling under the weather, so I stayed home and watched films.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Admin Officer)
lines.text: I am sorry to hear that. Oh, the manager is here. Let us grab our seats.

questions.q: Why is Hoa working from home today?
What did Lan do at the weekend?
options: She stayed home because she felt unwell

shadowing: The traffic was terrible this morning because of the heavy rain.
